verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents first-party AI tooling for this story. Its MCP server lets AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf) "generate infrastructure code" and delegate tasks to Neo, and Neo accepts plain-English requests (e.g., "Give me a VPC with a subnet in every AZ"). Missing for 10: detailed docs on Neo producing editable IaC code rather than just executing changes, evidence of NL generation built directly into the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
